items.title: ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps
items.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 with "Intelligent UI," a feature that turns answers into interactive interfaces with charts, buttons, and forms. The model can now respond while still thinking, cutting wait times by 44 percent. Paying customers get GPT-6 Sol, free users get GPT-6 Luna. The article ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在推出配備「智慧介面 (Intelligent UI)」的 GPT-6，這是一項能將回答轉化為包含圖表、按鈕與表單之互動式介面的功能。該模型現在能在思考的同時進行回應，將等待時間縮短了 44%。付費客戶可獲得 GPT-6 Sol，免費使用者則獲得 GPT-6 Luna。文章 ChatGPT 搭配 GPT-6 放棄了大部分的文字輸出，轉而採用包含圖表、按鈕與微型應用程式的互動式 UI，最早出現在 The Decoder。

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over
items.summary: Anthropic's new Claude Haiku 5.5 crushes its predecessor in benchmarks, jumping from 15.7 to 72.4 percent on the OSWorld computer use test. Token prices drop by up to 90 percent, though a new tokenizer eats into some of those savings by consuming more tokens per task. The article Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic's 的全新 Claude Haiku 5.5 在基準測試中大幅超越前代產品，在 OSWorld 電腦使用測試中從 15.7% 跳升至 72.4%。代幣價格最高下跌 90%，不過新的分詞器因為每個任務消耗更多代幣，吃掉了部分節省的成本。文章 Claude Haiku 5.5 挾帶大幅降價登場，證明 AI 價格戰遠未結束首次出現於 The Decoder。

items.title: Zuckerberg's Biohub leads a $1.8 billion push to build AI models that predict cell behavior
items.summary: Biohub, the research organization backed by Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan, is coordinating a $1.8 billion initiative to train AI models that predict cell behavior. Meta, Google DeepMind, Isomorphic Labs, and the US Department of Energy are funding data, lab equipment, and compute. A first dataset should be ready in about a year. The article Zuckerberg's Biohub leads a $1.8 billion push to build AI models that predict cell behavior appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Google says 180 billion images and videos now carry SynthID watermarks as detector goes public
items.summary: Google's AI watermark detector SynthID is now public. Anyone can check whether images, videos, or audio were created by Google's AI or partners like OpenAI and Nvidia. More than 180 billion pieces of content already carry the watermark, but the tool only identifies SynthID-tagged content, not AI-generated media in general. The article Google says 180 billion images and videos now carry SynthID watermarks as detector goes public appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one
items.summary: OpenAI's new Decisions API classifies text and images about ten times faster than the Responses API, returning yes/no probabilities, category picks, or scale ratings for $0.10 per million input tokens. The company also cut its paid API tiers from five to three. The article OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations
items.summary: OpenAI's teen safety features for ChatGPT failed an independent audit. After more than 4,000 test prompts, the Common Sense Media Youth AI Safety Institute rated the service an "unacceptable risk" for minors. Conversations about suicide and self-harm on test accounts never triggered a parental alert. The institute wants teenagers locked out until safety can be independently verified. The article ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI's 針對 ChatGPT 的青少年安全功能未能透過獨立稽核。經過 4,000 多個測試提示後，常識媒體青少年人工智慧安全研究所（Common Sense Media Youth AI Safety Institute）將該服務評為對未成年人具有「不可接受的風險」。測試帳號中關於自殺和自殘的對話從未觸發家長警報。該研究所希望在能夠獨立驗證安全性之前，禁止青少年使用。相關文章 ChatGPT 評定「不可接受的風險」：在自殺對話期間家長警報失敗後出現青少年風險，首先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions
items.summary: Anthropic is expanding its Cyber Verification Program, giving more security professionals access to Claude models with fewer safety restrictions for penetration testing, malware analysis, and vulnerability research. Anthropic says partners in its predecessor program found at least 129,000 confirmed vulnerabilities from April through July 2026, including more than 33,000 rated high-severity or critical. The article Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在擴大其網路驗證計畫（Cyber Verification Program），讓更多資安專業人員能夠使用 Claude 模型，並放寬安全限制，以便進行滲透測試、惡意軟體分析和漏洞研究。Anthropic 表示，其前身計畫的合作夥伴在 2026 年 4 月至 7 月期間發現了至少 12,9000 個已確認的漏洞，其中超過 33,000 個被評定為高嚴重性或重大漏洞。文章 Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up
items.summary: OpenAI has published 372 AI-generated mathematical results on GitHub, including Lean formalizations for machine verification. Each result consumed about three hours of ChatGPT Pro compute on average. But 25 Fields Medal winners warn that mass-producing mathematical truths could destroy fertile ground rather than bring new ideas to life. The article OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 已在 GitHub 上發布了 372 個 AI 生成的數學成果，其中包括用於機器驗證的 Lean 型式化。每個成果平均消耗了大約三小時的 ChatGPT Pro 算力。但 25 位菲爾茲獎得主警告稱，大量生產數學真理可能會摧毀肥沃的土壤，而不是為新點子賦予生命。這篇文章 OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
items.summary: 製造業推動後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）轉型，面臨的問題不只是更換加密演演算法。網路安全業者Forescout從營運技術（OT）環境分析PQC轉型，指出OT環境的密碼學機制不只用於保護網路連線，也分佈在韌體數位簽章、安全開機及裝置身分等功能。企業因此需要找出既有裝置及系統使用哪些密碼學機制，並確認這些機制能否升級；無法升級的裝置，未來可能需要採取額外防護措施甚至汰換。

items.summary: 近日大映科技揭露AI網路封包分析系統ANMAS（AI Network Malware Analysis System）的最新發展，並攜手多方夥伴拓展IoT、OT與企業網路安全等應用。除了供應鏈檢測與場域合作，大映科技總經理劉得民也進一步說明ANMAS如何將AI運用於網路封包分析。 關於ANMAS的實際運作，劉得民指出，IoT設備的網路封包一般可透過交換器或Wi-Fi等方式取得，ANMAS則採用虛擬Wi-Fi環境擷取設備通訊流量，之後再由工程師將封包擷取（Packet Capture，PCAP）檔案送交系統，由AI模型進一步分析。

items.title: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
items.summary: 資安院新任院長龔化中上任至今已有兩個月，最近公開「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖，主張以AI對抗AI。四項重點工作搭配六大中心的時程與數字，勾勒出臺灣資安防線下一版的樣貌，其中最受矚目的一場AI紅隊演練，預計明年四月登場。 AI攻擊速度加快，國家資安防禦必須重新設計 龔化中在8月1日開始擔任資安院院長，10月5日首度對外說明上任兩個月來的工作方向，公佈「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖。這套新架構的核心很明確：面對AI帶來的新型攻擊，防守方不能再只靠人工分析與既有流程應對，必須把AI納入國家資安防禦體系，讓攻擊與防禦雙方進入新的競爭階段。

items.title: Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA
items.summary: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late comes in 2 sizes: a 0.6B model built to run on edge devices, and a 9B model for building high-quality indexes. Its best score is 92.4% on MADQA, and its weakest is 61.2% on ViDoRe v3 Markdown. Both are MIT-licensed and ready to self-host. The post Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late 提供兩種尺寸：專為在邊緣裝置上運行而打造的 0.6B 模型，以及用於建構高品質索引的 9B 模型。它在 MADQA 上的最高得分為 92.4%，在 ViDoRe v3 Markdown 上的最低得分為 61.2%。兩者皆採用 MIT 授權，並可隨時自行託管。這篇文章 Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.summary: 加州非營利組織Common Sense Media報告稱，OpenAI的ChatGPT青少年模式對未成年人風險過高。測試顯示，青少年長時間討論自殺、自傷或進食障礙等高風險話題時，系統常無法及時向家長預警，也未穩定提供危機幹預熱線；往往需數週、數百條提示才可能觸發家長通知，安全防護明顯不足。

items.title: Claude悄悄上線簡繁體中文界面：產品菜單中文化，官方尚未官宣
items.summary: Anthropic正推進Claude中文化。用戶發現，其網頁版和桌面端語言菜單已新增簡體中文與繁體中文選項，部分賬號打開即顯示中文界面。此次更新並非新增中文對話能力，Claude早已支持中文聊天，而是將產品界面本身中文化。此前中文用戶只能使用英文等界面或依賴瀏覽器翻譯，如今這道使用門檻正被抹平。此舉意味着Claude本地化更進一步。

items.title: What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs
items.summary: Unsloth's October 6 security overview explains how Studio checks code, weights, packages and tools before anything runs. Custom model code is scanned and approval is bound to its fingerprint. Flagged weight files are blocked in the load path, package-content findings fail CI, and tools run in probed OS sandboxes. Here is what each checkpoint decides, and what it does not cover. The post What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Unsloth 在 10 月 6 日的安全概述中解釋了 Studio 如何在任何程式碼執行之前檢查程式碼、權重、套件和工具。自訂模型程式碼會遭到掃描，且核准會繫結至其指紋。遭標記的權重檔案會在載入路徑中遭到阻擋，套件內容的檢測結果會導致 CI 失敗，而工具則會在探測的作業系統沙箱中執行。以下是每個檢查點所決定的事項以及它所未涵蓋的範圍。這篇文章「What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.summary: Anthropic於10月8日發佈Claude Haiku5.5，定位爲迄今最快、能力最強的小型模型，面向高頻、成本敏感任務，如摘要、分類、數據庫查詢、客服應答、瀏覽器自動化和大型AI智能體子任務。官方稱其平均運行成本較上一代大幅降低，意在用輕量高效覆蓋高性價比場景。

items.title: OpenAI全量推送GPT-6：聊天框長出交互界面，免費用戶也能玩上智能UI
items.summary: OpenAI於10月8日向全球ChatGPT用戶推出新一代旗艦GPT-6，逐步接替GPT-5.6 Sol與Luna。重點不在模型性能，而是ChatGPT首次引入“智能UI”交互層：回答不再限於純文字，可自主選擇圖文、圖表、按鈕、表單甚至可操作小界面，並在對話框內實時生成。升級覆蓋Plus、Pro等多檔用戶。

items.title: Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal Decision Models With Zero Output Tokens
items.summary: Liquid AI has released Open d1, two open-weight multimodal models in its d1 decision model family. d1-3B reads text and images. d1-omni-600M reads text with an image, or text with audio. Neither model writes text. Each returns calibrated, typed answers in one forward pass with zero output tokens. The target is real-time decisions on the […] The post Liquid AI Releases Open-Weight d1-3B and d1-omni-600M: Multimodal Decision Models With Zero Output Tokens appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Liquid AI 已發布 Open d1，這是其 d1 決策模型系列中的兩個開源權重多模態模型。d1-3B 可讀取文字與圖片。d1-omni-600M 可讀取帶有圖片的文字，或帶有音訊的文字。兩個模型都不會寫文字。每個模型在一次前向傳遞中、且輸出代碼數為零的情況下，皆能傳回經過校準且具型別的答案。其目標是實現 […] 上的即時決策。這篇文章 Liquid AI 發布開源權重 d1-3B 與 d1-omni-600M：輸出代碼數為零的多模態決策模型，最早出現在 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day
items.summary: Meta has open-sourced Rebalancer, the C++ and Python library it has used for over 9 years to place shards, servers and traffic. It handles about 40 million assignment problems a day, using local search or MIP solvers like Gurobi, FICO Xpress and HiGHS. It is pip-installable under Apache 2.0. The post Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Meta 已開源其使用超過 9 年的 C++ 與 Python 庫 Rebalancer，用於配置分片、伺服器和流量。它每天處理約 4000 萬個指派問題，使用區域搜尋或 MIP 求解器，例如 Gurobi、FICO Xpress 和 HiGHS。它可在 Apache 2.0 授權下透過 pip 安裝。這篇文章 Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day 最早發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: As previously promised , here's Anthropic's new fast, low cost model: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 . The previous Haiku, 4.5, was very much showing its age. It came out almost a year ago , and was priced at $1/million input and $5/million output - relatively expensive even back then, and a full 10x the price of OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna , released last month. The new Haiku exactly matches the price of GPT-6 Luna - $0.10/$0.50 - up to 100,000 tokens. Beyond 100,000 tokens the price increases 5x to $0.50/$2.50. Luna itself has a price increase at 272,000 tokens but only to $0.20/$0.75. Haiku 5.5 also uses a new, less generous tokenizer. My Claude Token Counter tool shows that the same long prompt uses around 1.25x as many tokens with Haiku 5.5 compared to Haiku 4.5, so there's a hidden price increase there. If your workloads fit in 100,000 tokens, Haiku is the same price as Luna and reports higher benchmark scores. Above 100,000 tokens, Luna looks like a much better deal. The most recent release of llm-anthropic finally fixed it so I don't need to ship a new version of that plugin for every new model. I tested the new model like this: llm install -U llm-anthropic llm anthropic refresh llm -m claude-haiku-5.5 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" -o thinking_effort low Pelicans Here are pelicans for low, medium, high, xhigh, and max . The new Haiku doesn't let you disable reasoning, and defaults to medium . I got a good bicycle frame for everything beyond low . The low effort pelican cost 0.0936 cents and took 7 seconds. items.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: As previously promised , here's Anthropic's new fast, low cost model: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 . The previous Haiku, 4.5, was very much showing its age. It came out almost a year ago , and was priced at $1/million input and $5/million output - relatively expensive even back then, and a full 10x the price of OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna , released last month. The new Haiku exactly matches the price of GPT-6 Luna - $0.10/$0.50 - up to 100,000 tokens. Beyond 100,000 tokens the price increases 5x to $0.50/$2.50. Luna itself has a price increase at 272,000 tokens but only to $0.20/$0.75. Haiku 5.5 also uses a new, less generous tokenizer. My Claude Token Counter tool shows that the same long prompt uses around 1.25x as many tokens with Haiku 5.5 compared to Haiku 4.5, so there's a hidden price increase there. If your workloads fit in 100,000 tokens, Haiku is the same price as Luna and reports higher benchmark scores. Above 100,000 tokens, Luna looks like a much better deal. The most recent release of llm-anthropic finally fixed it so I don't need to ship a new version of that plugin for every new model. I tested the new model like this: llm install -U llm-anthropic llm anthropic refresh llm -m claude-haiku-5.5 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" -o thinking_effort low Pelicans Here are pelicans for low, medium, high, xhigh, and max . items_ai.title: ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps
items_ai.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 with "Intelligent UI," a feature that turns answers into interactive interfaces with charts, buttons, and forms. The model can now respond while still thinking, cutting wait times by 44 percent. Paying customers get GPT-6 Sol, free users get GPT-6 Luna. The article ChatGPT with GPT-6 ditches mostly text output for interactive UI with charts, buttons, and mini apps appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在推出配備「智慧介面 (Intelligent UI)」的 GPT-6，這是一項能將回答轉化為包含圖表、按鈕與表單之互動式介面的功能。該模型現在能在思考的同時進行回應，將等待時間縮短了 44%。付費客戶可獲得 GPT-6 Sol，免費使用者則獲得 GPT-6 Luna。文章 ChatGPT 搭配 GPT-6 放棄了大部分的文字輸出，轉而採用包含圖表、按鈕與微型應用程式的互動式 UI，最早出現在 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over
items_ai.summary: Anthropic's new Claude Haiku 5.5 crushes its predecessor in benchmarks, jumping from 15.7 to 72.4 percent on the OSWorld computer use test. Token prices drop by up to 90 percent, though a new tokenizer eats into some of those savings by consuming more tokens per task. The article Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives with massive price cuts proving the AI pricing arms race is far from over appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic's 的全新 Claude Haiku 5.5 在基準測試中大幅超越前代產品，在 OSWorld 電腦使用測試中從 15.7% 跳升至 72.4%。代幣價格最高下跌 90%，不過新的分詞器因為每個任務消耗更多代幣，吃掉了部分節省的成本。文章 Claude Haiku 5.5 挾帶大幅降價登場，證明 AI 價格戰遠未結束首次出現於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Zuckerberg's Biohub leads a $1.8 billion push to build AI models that predict cell behavior
items_ai.summary: Biohub, the research organization backed by Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan, is coordinating a $1.8 billion initiative to train AI models that predict cell behavior. Meta, Google DeepMind, Isomorphic Labs, and the US Department of Energy are funding data, lab equipment, and compute. A first dataset should be ready in about a year. The article Zuckerberg's Biohub leads a $1.8 billion push to build AI models that predict cell behavior appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 由馬克・祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）和普莉希拉・陳（Priscilla Chan）支持的研究組織 Biohub 正在協調一項 18 億美元的計畫，旨在訓練能夠預測細胞行為的 AI 模型。Meta、Google DeepMind、Isomorphic Labs 以及美國能源部正在為資料、實驗室設備和運算提供資金。第一批資料集大約在一年內準備就緒。這篇名為〈祖克柏的 Biohub 主導 18 億美元計畫，打造預測細胞行為的 AI 模型〉的文章最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Google says 180 billion images and videos now carry SynthID watermarks as detector goes public
items_ai.summary: Google's AI watermark detector SynthID is now public. Anyone can check whether images, videos, or audio were created by Google's AI or partners like OpenAI and Nvidia. More than 180 billion pieces of content already carry the watermark, but the tool only identifies SynthID-tagged content, not AI-generated media in general. The article Google says 180 billion images and videos now carry SynthID watermarks as detector goes public appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google's 的 AI 浮水印偵測器 SynthID 現已公開。任何人都可以檢查圖片、影片或音訊是否由 Google's AI 或 OpenAI 與輝達（Nvidia）等合作夥伴所建立。已有超過 1,800 億件內容帶有該浮水印，但該工具僅能識別帶有 SynthID 標記的內容，無法識別一般的 AI 生成媒體。這篇名為〈Google 表示，隨著偵測器公開，已有 1,800 億張圖片和影片帶有 SynthID 浮水印〉的文章最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one
items_ai.summary: OpenAI's new Decisions API classifies text and images about ten times faster than the Responses API, returning yes/no probabilities, category picks, or scale ratings for $0.10 per million input tokens. The company also cut its paid API tiers from five to three. The article OpenAI launches Decisions API that reduces complex evaluations to yes, no, or pick one appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.title: ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations
items_ai.summary: OpenAI's teen safety features for ChatGPT failed an independent audit. After more than 4,000 test prompts, the Common Sense Media Youth AI Safety Institute rated the service an "unacceptable risk" for minors. Conversations about suicide and self-harm on test accounts never triggered a parental alert. The institute wants teenagers locked out until safety can be independently verified. The article ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI's 針對 ChatGPT 的青少年安全功能未能透過獨立稽核。經過 4,000 多個測試提示後，常識媒體青少年人工智慧安全研究所（Common Sense Media Youth AI Safety Institute）將該服務評為對未成年人具有「不可接受的風險」。測試帳號中關於自殺和自殘的對話從未觸發家長警報。該研究所希望在能夠獨立驗證安全性之前，禁止青少年使用。相關文章 ChatGPT 評定「不可接受的風險」：在自殺對話期間家長警報失敗後出現青少年風險，首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions
items_ai.summary: Anthropic is expanding its Cyber Verification Program, giving more security professionals access to Claude models with fewer safety restrictions for penetration testing, malware analysis, and vulnerability research. Anthropic says partners in its predecessor program found at least 129,000 confirmed vulnerabilities from April through July 2026, including more than 33,000 rated high-severity or critical. The article Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在擴大其網路驗證計畫（Cyber Verification Program），讓更多資安專業人員能夠使用 Claude 模型，並放寬安全限制，以便進行滲透測試、惡意軟體分析和漏洞研究。Anthropic 表示，其前身計畫的合作夥伴在 2026 年 4 月至 7 月期間發現了至少 12,9000 個已確認的漏洞，其中超過 33,000 個被評定為高嚴重性或重大漏洞。文章 Anthropic gives more security teams access to Claude with fewer safety restrictions appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.title: OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up
items_ai.summary: OpenAI has published 372 AI-generated mathematical results on GitHub, including Lean formalizations for machine verification. Each result consumed about three hours of ChatGPT Pro compute on average. But 25 Fields Medal winners warn that mass-producing mathematical truths could destroy fertile ground rather than bring new ideas to life. The article OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 已在 GitHub 上發布了 372 個 AI 生成的數學成果，其中包括用於機器驗證的 Lean 型式化。每個成果平均消耗了大約三小時的 ChatGPT Pro 算力。但 25 位菲爾茲獎得主警告稱，大量生產數學真理可能會摧毀肥沃的土壤，而不是為新點子賦予生命。這篇文章 OpenAI dumps 372 AI-generated math proofs on GitHub, telling the academic world to keep up 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
items_ai.summary: 製造業推動後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）轉型，面臨的問題不只是更換加密演演算法。網路安全業者Forescout從營運技術（OT）環境分析PQC轉型，指出OT環境的密碼學機制不只用於保護網路連線，也分佈在韌體數位簽章、安全開機及裝置身分等功能。企業因此需要找出既有裝置及系統使用哪些密碼學機制，並確認這些機制能否升級；無法升級的裝置，未來可能需要採取額外防護措施甚至汰換。

items_ai.summary: 近日大映科技揭露AI網路封包分析系統ANMAS（AI Network Malware Analysis System）的最新發展，並攜手多方夥伴拓展IoT、OT與企業網路安全等應用。除了供應鏈檢測與場域合作，大映科技總經理劉得民也進一步說明ANMAS如何將AI運用於網路封包分析。 關於ANMAS的實際運作，劉得民指出，IoT設備的網路封包一般可透過交換器或Wi-Fi等方式取得，ANMAS則採用虛擬Wi-Fi環境擷取設備通訊流量，之後再由工程師將封包擷取（Packet Capture，PCAP）檔案送交系統，由AI模型進一步分析。

items_ai.title: 龔化中上任兩個月揭「國家資安防護2.0」，明年4月AI紅隊先攻政府機關
items_ai.summary: 資安院新任院長龔化中上任至今已有兩個月，最近公開「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖，主張以AI對抗AI。四項重點工作搭配六大中心的時程與數字，勾勒出臺灣資安防線下一版的樣貌，其中最受矚目的一場AI紅隊演練，預計明年四月登場。 AI攻擊速度加快，國家資安防禦必須重新設計 龔化中在8月1日開始擔任資安院院長，10月5日首度對外說明上任兩個月來的工作方向，公佈「國家資安防護2.0」藍圖。這套新架構的核心很明確：面對AI帶來的新型攻擊，防守方不能再只靠人工分析與既有流程應對，必須把AI納入國家資安防禦體系，讓攻擊與防禦雙方進入新的競爭階段。

items_ai.title: Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA
items_ai.summary: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late comes in 2 sizes: a 0.6B model built to run on edge devices, and a 9B model for building high-quality indexes. Its best score is 92.4% on MADQA, and its weakest is 61.2% on ViDoRe v3 Markdown. Both are MIT-licensed and ready to self-host. The post Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Perplexity's pplx-embed-v2-late 提供兩種尺寸：專為在邊緣裝置上運行而打造的 0.6B 模型，以及用於建構高品質索引的 9B 模型。它在 MADQA 上的最高得分為 92.4%，在 ViDoRe v3 Markdown 上的最低得分為 61.2%。兩者皆採用 MIT 授權，並可隨時自行託管。這篇文章 Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late: A 0.6B Edge Model and a 9B Model Scoring 92.4% on MADQA 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.summary: Anthropic正推進Claude中文化。用戶發現，其網頁版和桌面端語言菜單已新增簡體中文與繁體中文選項，部分賬號打開即顯示中文界面。此次更新並非新增中文對話能力，Claude早已支持中文聊天，而是將產品界面本身中文化。此前中文用戶只能使用英文等界面或依賴瀏覽器翻譯，如今這道使用門檻正被抹平。此舉意味着Claude本地化更進一步。

items_ai.summary: 谷歌被曝正爲Gmail開發Gemini驅動的AI收件箱。開發者拆解Gmail v2026.09.28 APK後發現相關代碼，暗示Gemini智能體可自動處理郵件回覆。代碼註釋顯示，功能上線後，AI收件箱會在待辦事項旁出現“使用Gemini”按鈕，讓AI代寫回信，或意味着Gmail將把回郵件交給AI。

items_ai.title: What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs
items_ai.summary: Unsloth's October 6 security overview explains how Studio checks code, weights, packages and tools before anything runs. Custom model code is scanned and approval is bound to its fingerprint. Flagged weight files are blocked in the load path, package-content findings fail CI, and tools run in probed OS sandboxes. Here is what each checkpoint decides, and what it does not cover. The post What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Unsloth 在 10 月 6 日的安全概述中解釋了 Studio 如何在任何程式碼執行之前檢查程式碼、權重、套件和工具。自訂模型程式碼會遭到掃描，且核准會繫結至其指紋。遭標記的權重檔案會在載入路徑中遭到阻擋，套件內容的檢測結果會導致 CI 失敗，而工具則會在探測的作業系統沙箱中執行。以下是每個檢查點所決定的事項以及它所未涵蓋的範圍。這篇文章「What Happens When a Trusted Model Repo Changes? Unsloth Studio Re-Checks Before It Runs」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Meta AI Open-Sources Rebalancer: A C++ Assignment Solver That Runs About 40 Million Placement Problems a Day
items_ai.summary: Meta has open-sourced Rebalancer, the C++ and Python library it has used for over 9 years to place shards, servers and traffic. Luna itself has a price increase at 272,000 tokens but only to $0.20/$0.75. Haiku 5.5 also uses a new, less generous tokenizer. My Claude Token Counter tool shows that the same long prompt uses around 1.25x as many tokens with Haiku 5.5 compared to Haiku 4.5, so there's a hidden price increase there. If your workloads fit in 100,000 tokens, Haiku is the same price as Luna and reports higher benchmark scores. Above 100,000 tokens, Luna looks like a much better deal. items_ai.summary_zh: 如先前所承諾，以下是 Anthropic's 全新且快速、低成本的模型：介紹 Claude Haiku 5.5。先前的 Haiku（4.5）已經顯得有些過時。它將近在一年前推出，定價為每百萬輸入 1 美元、每百萬輸出 5 美元 — 即使在當時也相對昂貴，且價格高達上個月發布的 OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna 的 10 倍。全新的 Haiku 在 100,000 個 Token 以內完全符合 GPT-6 Luna 的價格 — $0.10/$0.50。超過 100,000 個 Token 後，價格會增加 5 倍，達到 $0.50/$2.50。Luna 本身在 272,000 個 Token 時價格會調漲，但僅調漲至 $0.20/$0.75。Haiku 5.5 也使用了較不慷慨的新 Tokenizer。我的 Claude Token 計數器工具顯示，與 Haiku 4.5 相比，Haiku 5.5 在處理同一個長提示詞時會多使用約 1.25 倍的 Token，因此其中存在隱性價格漲幅。如果你的工作負載在 100,000 個 Token 以內，Haiku 的價格與 Luna 相同，且回報了更高的基準測試分數。在 100,000 個 Token 以上，Luna 看起來是個划算得多的選擇。llm-anthropic 的最新版本終於修復了這個問題，所以我不需要為每個新模型都發布該外掛程式的新版本。我測試新模型的方式如下：llm install -U llm-anthropic llm anthropic refresh llm -m claude-haiku-5.5 "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" -o thinking_effort low Pelicans 這裡有針對 low、medium、high、xhigh 和 max 的鵜鶘。全新的 Haiku 不允許你停用推理，且預設為 medium。對於 low 以外的所有設定，我都獲得了不錯的自行車車架。low 努力程度的鵜鶘花費了 0.0936 美分，耗時 7 秒。這個 max 努力程度的鵜鶘（帶有推理追蹤，其）
